author: claude
summary: Task 003: split the two oversized API routers (app/api/routers/generation.py 859L, app/api/routers/engines.py 704L) along their internal seams into a facade + sub-router files, matching the repo's existing voices_*/chapters_* filename-prefix convention. Facade modules re-export names for backward compatibility so app/api/web.py's app.include_router(generation.router)/app.include_router(engines.router) calls are unchanged; no route path, method, or ordering changes. A cluster of tests in tests/api/test_api_generation.py, tests/api/test_api_engines.py, tests/api/test_api.py, and tests/domain/test_segment_variation_synthesis.py that used unittest.mock.patch on app.api.routers.generation.<name>/app.api.routers.engines.<name> module attributes had their patch targets retargeted to the sub-module that now actually owns that name (a function's global lookups resolve against the module it is *defined* in, not one that merely re-imports it).

files.change: Reduced from 859 lines to a 42-line facade: builds the /api-prefixed router by including generation_chapters/generation_queue/generation_segments sub-routers and re-exports their route functions plus generation_shared's helpers for backward-compatible direct imports.

New file (349L). Non-route helpers extracted from generation.py: engine-usability/validation checks (_engine_usable_error, _ensure_engines_enabled, _validate_generation_engines), segment-profile resolution (_resolved_segment_profiles, _engines_for_profiles), and chapter script/task construction (_build_script_for_chapter, _build_chapter_synthesis_task).
New file (353L). Chapter-level render submission routes: POST /api/processing_queue (api_add_to_queue) and POST /api/generation/bake/{chapter_id} (api_bake_chapter).
New file (61L). Queue-level controls: POST /api/generation/pause, /resume, /cancel-all, and POST /api/chapters/{chapter_id}/cancel.
New file (168L). Segment-level render submission: POST /api/segments/generate (api_generate_segments).

Reduced from 704 lines to a 56-line facade: builds the /api/engines-prefixed router by including engines_registry/engines_plugins/engines_test sub-routers (each carrying its own /api/engines prefix to satisfy FastAPI's empty-path-on-include_router check for the bare GET "" route) and re-exports their route functions plus engines_shared's helpers.

New file (109L). Non-route helpers extracted from engines.py: GithubPreviewRequest/ConcurrencyUpdateRequest pydantic models, _check_engine_id, _is_generated_sample_name, _resolve_plugin_dir, _safe_resolve_plugin_dir.

New file (224L). Registry/discovery/settings/concurrency/calibration routes: list_engines, get_official_registry_list, get_engine_concurrency, update_engine_concurrency, update_engine_settings, clear_engine_setting, get_engine_requirements, remove_engine_plugin, get_engine_logs, reset_engine_calibration.

New file (192L). Plugin install/import/staging management routes: refresh_plugins, install_engine_dependencies, import_engine_plugin, preview_engine_plugin, preview_github_plugin, confirm_engine_plugin, cancel_engine_plugin_staging.
New file (219L). Engine verify/self-test/dev-scenario/asset routes: verify_engine, get_test_audio, test_engine, get_engine_scenarios, get_engine_asset.

Retargeted ~50 unittest.mock.patch/monkeypatch.setattr calls from app.api.routers.generation.<name> to the correct owning sub-module (generation_chapters/generation_queue/generation_segments/generation_shared); also added a matching patch of generation_shared.create_orchestrator alongside generation_chapters.create_orchestrator in 4 integration tests, since the child ChapterSynthesisTask's bridge dispatch is built inside generation_shared's own create_orchestrator() call.

Retargeted app.api.routers.engines.create_voice_bridge patches to engines_registry/engines_plugins/engines_test as appropriate; one test (settings+refresh) now patches both engines_registry and engines_plugins since it exercises routes in both modules.
